android.desc:
Decode the value of any resistor in seconds by selecting its color bands.
Whether you work with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, breadboard projects, or repair electronics, this app gives you a fast and reliable way to read resistor color codes - no calculation, no lookup tables, no guesswork.
Perfect for makers, hobbyists, electronics engineers, technicians, and students learning electronics for the first time.

Key Features
- Supports 4-band and 5-band resistors
- Tap the color rings to instantly see the resistance value in ohms
- Includes tolerance values
- Clean, distraction-free interface
- Works completely offline
- Based on the industry-standard EIA color code

Whether you're building a circuit, debugging a project, or studying for an exam, the Resistor Color Code Calculator makes reading resistor values effortless.

Download now and keep a complete color code reference in your pocket.
